player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Muzinda {player_id} unotamba gema rePig Dice.

Mitanuro:
- Pa turn yako, unogona kuita '[roll]' kana '[hold]'
- Kukumbura 2-6: Ongeza kwenyu kudhinda kwako
- Kukumbura 1: Pota kudhinda kwako na imwa turn
- Garai: Ongeza kudhinda kwako kwenyu score na imwa turn
- Wekutanga kuwana {winning_score} point ndiye anowina

Unopota turn yako, unogona kuwona makore ekudhinda ari kare na kudhinda kwako. 
Rerespondi na '[roll]' kukumbura die kana '[hold]' kubata point yako.
